name: launch-check-extension
description: Browser extension: launch check and passive secret-leak scan for the site in the current tab.

scripts.e2e: E2E=1 wxt build && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.screenshots: E2E=1 wxt build && SHOTS=1 vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/screenshots.e2e.ts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && wxt build && wxt build -b firefox --mv3 && vitest run && web-ext lint -s .output/firefox-mv3
